note: Single column, mixed page of support staff so page school is district-wide. ELEMENTARY PLAYGROUND AIDES (line 1) -> passios (both aides named for the Elementary Annex / Elementary School). HEALTH SERVICES (line 10): physician and clerk/typist -> district-wide; nurses are placed by the printed 'Office:' (Elementary School -> passios, Middle School -> middle, High School -> high), which is where the nurse sits, not necessarily the only building served (they are 'Town & School Nurse'). CUSTODIAL SERVICES (line 32): Okerman 'Supervisor/Foreman of Buildings & Grounds (Office: Brooks House)' -> district-wide; under sub-heading HIGH SCHOOL (line 37) Paton, Ebersole, Gilmour -> high (continues p140). Role on the same line for the custodians. Honorifics kept as printed. Line 5-6 is a note about Baker's expanded position; line 41 page number. Integration pass, 31 Oct 2026: school bus contractors, drivers and volunteers moved from entries to ignored (not school staff; every 1971-1980 page treated alike), and `middle` written `turkey-hill` -- the 1972 and 1974 listings print the building as `Turkey Hill Middle School (Grades 5-7)`, the town's one middle school.
